description: Flyway migrations and relational schema for Spring Boot: review or create files under db/migration, naming and version order, checksum/validation failures, evolving applied migrations, table/constraint/index design, entity-to-schema mapping and native queries. Use when asked whether a migration is correct, how to name or evolve it, how a schema should change, or to diagnose database connection failures and locks. For slow endpoints, N+1 queries or pool sizing use spring-boot-performance.
